description: One financial fact a listed company DISCLOSED in its primary filing, registered as an AT Protocol record. Non-adjudicating (G2) / no investment advice (G4): a disclosed number or a transparent ratio of two disclosed numbers — never a rating, valuation, forecast, or recommendation. Provenance anchored to the source filing and its IPFS doc-cid.

company.description: Shared org.corp.* entity id (same entity kabuto/tsumugi hold).

conceptRaw.description: Source taxonomy element kept for audit, e.g. ifrs-full:Revenue.

value.description: Disclosed figure as a decimal string (no float rounding loss).

source.description: Primary-disclosure source only (G1). :dart = KR 금융감독원 전자공시 (FSS DART); :cninfo = CN 巨潮资讯 (CSRC-designated). Both are official primary-disclosure systems analogous to EDINET/EDGAR — the filing, never a terminal.

docCid.description: IPFS CID of the source filing document (G8 — never git-lfs).

sourcing.description: G5 provenance: parsed-XBRL / rounded-headline / kanjo-derived ratio.

supersededBy.description: rkey/uri of a later 訂正報告書 fact that restates this one (G11 — history, never deletion).
